check.name: covers grade a run + others
cmd: import pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path('{result}').read_text(); sys.exit(0 if ('grade a run' in t and 'others' in t and 'Whys' in t) else 1)

check.name: all five types in the doc
cmd: import pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path('docs/FEEDBACK_TEMPLATES.md').read_text(); sys.exit(0 if all(x in t for x in ('grade a run','others','multi step planning','repo scanning','research and reports')) else 1)
